summary: Platform-specific prebuilt binary package with no observed malicious behavior
details: Package @camera.ui/camera-ui-nvr-windows-amd64 appears to be a platform-specific prebuilt binary distribution (Windows amd64 variant) for the camera.ui NVR component. No lifecycle scripts, no install-time network fetches, no credential reads, no exfiltration patterns, and no obfuscated loaders were observed in the shipped contents. The package ships only a small number of files consistent with a platform-gated binary artifact.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
